description: Shared correctness fixtures for the five storage variants (heapPrimitiveArray, confinedSegment, sharedSegment, slicedView, copiedBoundaryCrossing) over three datasets. Storage location and access path change ns/access and ns/record, never the checksum.

semantics.xorshift64: x ^= x << 13; x ^= x >>> 7 (unsigned/logical); x ^= x << 17 (64-bit wrapping, unsigned interpretation throughout)

fixedRecords.fields: id = i (linear, 8 bytes); value = xorshift64 stream unsigned-mod 1,000,000 (8 bytes); flag = xorshift64 stream unsigned-mod 8 (4 bytes, 4 bytes padding to keep the record 8-byte aligned) — two xorshift64 advances per record, in this order: value, flag
fixedRecords.checksum: wrapping sum of (id + value + flag) over all records

largeNumericBuffers.fields: value = xorshift64 stream unsigned-mod 1,000,000,000 (one advance per record) — deliberately large (40MB) to exceed typical L2/L3 cache and make storage-location access cost visible
largeNumericBuffers.checksum: wrapping sum of value over all records

binaryFrames.fields: length = 48 (constant, 4 bytes); type = xorshift64 stream unsigned-mod 4 (4 bytes); payload = 6 longs, xorshift64 stream unsigned-mod 1,000,000 each (48 bytes) — per record, one xorshift64 advance for type then six more for payload[0..6)
binaryFrames.checksum: wrapping sum of (length + type + sum(payload)) over all frames
